$comment: Hand-maintained input of fushi/tool/native_licenses.dart (run: cd fushi && dart run tool/native_licenses.dart).
rust: target triples each native/<crate>/Cargo.lock ships for, plus optional prepare steps; every native/*/Cargo.lock is discovered automatically.

rust.licenseTexts: for crates whose crates.io package ships no license file, "name@version" -> upstream original texts (from the commit in the crate's .cargo_vcs_info.json, stored under texts/crates/<owner>-<repo>-<sha8>/). appendSpdx adds the SPDX standard body when the upstream file has none. Crates without an entry fall back to spdx/ and are listed in the generated index (pendingUpstreamLicense).
cxx: C/C++ libraries compiled into this repo's native modules. texts point at the vendored original, or at a verbatim upstream copy in native/third_party_licenses/texts/.

prebuilt: native binaries that pub packages download or bundle into the app (Flutter's LicenseRegistry only collects each pub package's own LICENSE). Same fields as cxx plus source (evidence for version and license).
spdx/: SPDX standard texts, used only for crates that ship no license file.
